dates.notes: Adopted on the report of the First Committee (A/80/534, para. 7); document distributed 5 December 2025. relevance.reason: The 2025 follow-up to resolution 79/239 on artificial intelligence in the military domain. It reaffirms the applicability of international law, including international humanitarian law and human rights law, across the lifecycle of military AI capabilities. It remains non-binding.
